site: A 40-foot animated Christmas tree lit nightly at 6:30 PM
Towering toy soldiers along the Promenade
Nightly snow falls and live music
Pearl Express train rides at $8 and trampoline rides at $15
Free admission and free parking, pet friendly
about: Sunset Walk describes Holiday Nights as its Holiday Nights Celebration on the Promenade, a free evening event with Santa, towering toy soldiers and a nightly tree lighting at 6:30 PM. The Promenade is at 3251 Margaritaville Boulevard in Kissimmee.

Only select nights are open: November 27 to 29, December 3 to 6, December 10 to 13 and December 17 to 25. Hours are 6 to 10 PM. The venue lists more than 30 restaurants, arcades, movie theaters and shops on the Promenade.
S'mores are bought at the mobile bar outside The Wharf and toasted at the fire pit. Train rides run through the night from the North Pole Roundabout at $8 each, and the trampoline ride is $15.
Sunset Walk adds Dance Station Studios holiday performances on December 14, 16 and 21 from 6 to 7:15 PM, so those evenings fall outside the select nights listed for the lights.
faq: Is Holiday Nights at Sunset Walk free?
Admission and parking are free. Train rides cost $8 and trampoline rides cost $15.
Which nights is it open?
November 27 to 29, December 3 to 6, December 10 to 13 and December 17 to 25, 2026, from 6 to 10 PM.
When is the tree lit?
The 40-foot animated Christmas tree lights up nightly at 6:30 PM.
Can I bring my dog?
Sunset Walk lists the event as always pet friendly.
Where do I park?
Parking is free, according to Sunset Walk.

site: Petting zoo and animal meet and greets
7th annual event at a wildlife preserve
about: Amazing Animals Inc. is a nonprofit that keeps sloths, capybaras and other animal ambassadors at its preserve at 4235 Rambler Ave in St. Cloud. Its website lists Christmas in the Cloud as a family friendly holiday event that mixes Christmas with wildlife.
The day runs from 11 AM to 4 PM on Saturday, December 12, 2026. Santa and Mrs. Claus attend, and the preserve sets up a petting zoo, animal meet and greets, local vendors and food trucks.

Experience Kissimmee, the county tourism site, calls this the fifth annual event and lists $10 per person. The preserve's own website calls it the 7th annual, so the count differs between the two pages.
The preserve says it is visit by appointment only the rest of the year. Contact it at (407) 719-6269 for questions.
faq: How much is Christmas in the Cloud?
Experience Kissimmee lists $10 per person.
When is it?
Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 11 AM to 4 PM.
Where is it?
At the Amazing Animals Inc. wildlife preserve, 4235 Rambler Ave, St. Cloud, FL 34772.
Does Santa attend?
Yes, Santa and Mrs. Claus are listed as guests.
Is there food?
Food trucks are listed.
